description: Linchpin maintenance config with automerge enabled. Everything except the automerge behaviour is inherited from linchpin/renovatebot-config, which is the single source of truth for grouping, commit prefixes and package routing.

packageRules.description: Automerge non-major npm and Composer updates. In the previous duplicated config this was set individually on all nine non-major groups; the rule is uniform, so it is expressed once here.
Never automerge majors. Renovate already defaults to false; stated explicitly so a future automerge default in the base preset cannot silently enable it here.
Automerge non-major GitHub Actions updates on Monday mornings.
